newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil extends rally, diesel demand strong.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil extends rally, diesel demand strong.

text.p: NWE gas oil rallied strongly on Thursday and traders said prices may still have further to go.
IPE October futures closed $6.75 higher at $231.75 per tonne. The crack spread with Brent crude jumped to a three-year high of $6.70 per barrel.

Refinery problems in the U.K. have restricted the amount of low sulphur diesel on offer and up to four majors were looking to buy diesel into Hamburg, a seller said. This U.K. refiner was offering his cargo at Oct IPE +$20 cif.
A cargo of French GOM diesel was sold into Bordeaux at Oct IPE +$18.00 basis Le Havre for arrival October 8-13.
Some Russian cargoes from Ventspils were sold into Hamburg at a stronger $6.50-$7.50 premium to October, although traders holding other Russians were expecting premiums nearer $6.50.
A small German heating oil cargo was sold into Bremen at Oct IPE +$8.00, again at the higher end of recent talk.

Transatlantic arbitrage traders began to show U.S. material in Europe, often only as 0.2 percent sulphur, and offers centred around November +$6.00/6.50 cif. The quality of the cargoes varied and mostly did not conform to the European diesel specification.
